compiled_state.title: Implement _compact_preconditions() and snapshot-read path with retry-once in ticket-lib.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: ## Testing Mode GREEN ## Story 0263-62ba — Migrate 4 consumers to PRECONDITIONS, add compaction on epic-closure with ordering contract ## Objective Implement the compaction function and update `_read_latest_preconditions()` to transparently handle both flat events and the compacted snapshot format, with a retry-once on transient file-missing. ## Implementation Notes ### Files to Modify - `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh` — add `_compact_preconditions()`, update `_read_latest_preconditions()` ### _compact_preconditions(ticket_dir, epic_id) logic 1. Enumerate all `*-PRECONDITIONS.json` files in `<ticket_dir>` (exclude `*-PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json`) 2. Build a merged JSON payload applying LWW across composite keys (gate_name, session_id, worktree_id) per the established Story 1 contract 3. Write merged payload to a temp file `<ticket_dir>/<ts>-<uuid>-PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json.tmp` 4. Atomic rename (mv) the temp file to final `<ticket_dir>/<ts>-<uuid>-PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json` 5. Mark each original event file retired by appending `.retired` suffix (rename, not delete — preserve audit trail) 6. Emit: `[compact_preconditions] snapshot written: <snapshot_path>` to stderr ### _read_latest_preconditions() update 1. Check if `*-PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json` exists in ticket dir 2. If snapshot exists AND (no live PRECONDITIONS.json remain OR snapshot timestamp >= all live events): return snapshot 3. If no snapshot or live events are newer: run existing LWW resolution across live events (unchanged behavior) 4. Retry-once contract: if any stat/read operation fails with ENOENT, sleep 50ms and retry once; on second failure, return exit 1 with diagnostic message ### Contract invariants (from preplanning) - compaction_ordering: epic-closure validator MUST run before calling this function - atomic-rename to publish snapshot (no partial-write reads) - reader handles both flat events and snapshot format transparently ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] `declare -f _compact_preconditions` succeeds after sourcing ticket-lib.sh   Verify: bash -c 'source plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh && declare -f _compact_preconditions' | grep -q "_compact_preconditions" - [ ] test_compact_preconditions_writes_snapshot passes (GREEN)   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh test_compact_preconditions_writes_snapshot - [ ] test_read_latest_handles_snapshot_format passes (GREEN)   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh test_read_latest_handles_snapshot_format - [ ] test_read_latest_retry_once_on_transient_miss passes (GREEN)   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh test_read_latest_retry_once_on_transient_miss - [ ] No existing ticket-lib.sh tests regress   Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "PASS|FAIL" | tail -20 - [ ] `ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py` passes (exit 0)   Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py - [ ] Script is executable   Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages) On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
